definitions: To acknowledge and praise someone for their contributions or achievements, especially when they might otherwise be overlooked.
examples: I have to give credit where credit is due; Sarah did most of the work on this project.
Let's give credit where credit is due and thank the volunteers for their tireless efforts.
He was quick to give credit where credit is due, always recognizing his team's hard work.
lemma: to give credit where credit is due
source: to give credit where credit is due
